speech.heard: Pakistan has 21 times the diabetes rate of Zimbabwe. Is the highest rate in the USA, India or Pakistan? The USA sits at 13.7%. India has 10.5%, significant but far from the top. Pakistan sits at the very peak with 31.4%. At the other end, Zimbabwe drops to just 1.5%. This counts adults ages 20 to 79 with type 1 or type 2 diabetes. Kuwait 25.6%, Qatar 24.6%, Saudi Arabia 23.1%. How common is diabetes where you live?
